text: I think I need some advice, sorry if this is all over the place, I've barely slept in two days. My son is 5 months old and his temp is 39.2. About 20 mins ago he had what I think was a fit, he went stiff and his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes sort of rolled up. It lasted maybe a minute? Not sure, it felt longer. He's never done anything like that before. Then when I was changing him I noticed some little dark reddish purple dots on his tummy and I pressed a glass on them like they say and I'm pretty sure they didn't go away. I might be wrong but I don't think they faded at all
